name: Juujigen Rippoutai Cipher ~Aoki Tsuki no Suitei~
original_name: 十次元立方体サイファー～蒼き月の水底～
source: You and other people are part of some study, and you all have to live in a dark two-story mansion with all the windows shut closed with wooden planks.
translation: 你与其他人共同参与某项研究，所有人都必须住进一栋阴暗的两层宅邸，那里每扇窗户都被木板牢牢封死。
